fund_name: Grant Pool to Promote Energy Export Efforts
host: Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities
summary: This grant pool aims to support projects within green energy that promote Denmark's energy export efforts through expanding public-private cooperation and government collaborations in future growth markets. The fund supports initiatives that advance the Danish energy export by leveraging international partnerships and innovative green energy solutions.
eligible_applicants: Private companies active in green energy export
Consortia involving both private and public sector participants

deadlines.application_deadline: To be announced on the Danish Energy Agency and State Grant Pools websites

reporting_requirements: Final report on outcomes related to energy export promotion
